name: codex-oauth
description: Configure ZenMux Responses models in Codex with OAuth 2.0 PKCE and reversible setup.

interface.shortDescription: ZenMux models, OAuth PKCE, and reversible Codex setup.
interface.longDescription: ZenMux OAuth downloads the production Responses model catalog, configures a command-authenticated Codex model provider, manages short-lived OAuth tokens with PKCE and refresh rotation, and can restore the Codex configuration saved before installation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me connect Codex to ZenMux using OAuth PKCE.
